raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the lineage by skipping a generation. After noting that the 7th Duke was Charles Armand René (father of the 8th Duke), the Planner incorrectly concluded the paternal grandfather was the 6th Duke (Charles Louis Bretagne) instead of the 7th Duke (Charles Armand René), who is the actual father of Charles Bretagne Marie’s father. Reliance on an inconsistent Geni entry and failure to cross-check led to the wrong conclusion.
